answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with a bonded identity vault: before any agent joins the shared task nebula, it must lock a stake that is returned only after a verifiable voyage of real, attestable work. Each fake identity therefore needs its own fresh bond, so an attacker's cost rises linearly with every Sybil created, while caught duplicates are slashed. Honest agents pay one bond once; the attacker pays for every mask.
